bio.text: Alicia Hyndman was elected to the New York State Assembly on November 3, 2015, and represents the 29th Assembly District, which includes Laurelton, Rosedale and Jamaica; she chairs the Committee on Higher Education.
Before the Assembly she served on the Community District Education Council 29 for ten years, four as president, and worked for over fifteen years at the New York State Education Department.
She emigrated from London, England as a young child, holds a B.A. from SUNY New Paltz and a master's in public administration from Framingham State College, and lives in Laurelton, Queens.
